objective: Complete Phase 2 Promotion readiness: Enable Messenger Hub (Telegram/Discord) and Integrate Cloud Relay Health Card into Dashboard

tasks.title: Enable Telegram and Discord integrations in Settings
tasks.description: Modify frontend/src/components/Settings/IntegrationsTab.tsx to import TelegramTab and DiscordTab, and set available: true for both platforms.
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: Telegram and Discord cards in the Integrations tab are expandable and show their respective configuration components.

tasks.title: Integrate RelayHealthCard into Dashboard
tasks.description: Add the RelayHealthCard component to the main Dashboard page (frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx).
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: The Dashboard shows a live Cloud Relay health card with connection status, latency (ping), and connected device list.
